payload.friendly_name: Phase 3 Demo Journey Fidelity and Hygiene
payload.purpose_context: The Phase 3 mission shipped with every declared behavior proven audibly, but its retained live scene changes effect-slot and return occupancy by injecting semantic actions backstage instead of walking the player's on-screen PATCH and MIXER journey the phase exists to demonstrate. This corrective gate reworks the scene to travel that journey on screen, re-runs it on a physical device with refreshed evidence, and sweeps the post-merge review's seven open hygiene items so Phase 4 starts from a clean, honestly demonstrated baseline.
payload.purpose_tldr: Make the Phase 3 live demo walk the player's on-screen PATCH/MIXER journey and sweep the post-merge review's open items before Phase 4.
